name: awesome-opencode
description: Native OpenCode toolkit catalog and installer foundation

scripts.test:installer: bun run build && node --test dist/tests/toolkit-manifest.test.js dist/tests/installer-engine.test.js dist/tests/cli.test.js
scripts.test:opencode:schema: bun run build && node scripts/check-opencode.mjs schema
scripts.test:opencode:discovery: bun run build && node scripts/check-opencode.mjs discovery
scripts.validate: bun run build && node dist/installer/src/cli.js validate
scripts.prepare: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/schemas', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('schemas/toolkit.schema.json', 'dist/schemas/toolkit.schema.json')" && node dist/installer/src/cli.js validate
